components.name: Centered precision quotient and precision-locked actuation lattice
components.project_addition: Re-express the E002 target fiber as the zero cell of an exact centered odd-width Euclidean quotient; classify an integer translation as quotient-compatible exactly when the cell width divides the actuation increment; identify the gcd of cell width and a finite action family as the coarsest arbitrary-future centered repair; derive the actuator-induced odd-divisor precision spectrum, nested centered projections, shared-lcm actuation cost, and delay-safe quotient dynamics. General congruence/future-compatibility machinery remains P023-owned, and ordinary Euclidean division plus gcd/lcm arithmetic are established mathematics.
